work: Giovanni Ceva — De lineis rectis se invicem secantibus statica constructio (Milan: Ludovico Monza, 1678)
editions: De lineis rectis se invicem secantibus statica constructio. Ad Serenissimum Ferdinandum Carolum Ducem Mantuae, Montisferrati, Guastallae, &c. Auctore Ioanne Ceva Mediolanensi. Mediolani: Ex Typographia Ludovici Montiae, MDCLXXVIII ([16], 104 pp., 10 folding plates; BNCF Florence ita-bnc-mag-00001346-001)

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Axiomata I–II, Petitio & Lemmata I–II (1678, pp. 1–2; Tab. 1, Figs. 1–3)
entries.topic: Uniqueness of the static center of gravity and Archimedes' Law of the Lever (u · AF = v · FB, A : B = BF : FA)
entries.sister_locus: Archimedes On the Equilibrium of Planes I.4–7; Elements V & VI

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Elementum I & Prop. VIII (1678, pp. 2–3, 10–12; Tab. 1, Figs. 4, 12)
entries.topic: Static two-lever proof of Menelaus's Transversal Theorem and projective harmonic range (B, C; D, D') = -1
entries.sister_locus: Menelaus Sphaerica III Lemma 1; Ptolemy Almagest I.13; Pappus Synagoge VII

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Elementum II & Prop. VII (1678, pp. 3–4, 8–10; Tab. 1, Figs. 5, 11)
entries.topic: Interior cevian concurrency at P = (uA + vB + wC)/(u+v+w) iff (AF/FB)·(BD/DC)·(CE/EA) = 1
entries.sister_locus: Kimberling ETC barycentric centers X(1), X(2), X(4), X(6); College Geometry Ch. VII

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Elementum III & p. 5 Scholium (1678, pp. 4–5; Tab. 1, Fig. 6)
entries.topic: Analytic negative static weights ('pondus... more analytico F - A') for exterior cevian concurrency (e.g., excenter J_A)
entries.sister_locus: Signed homogeneous barycentric coordinates (Möbius 1827); excenters of triangle ABC

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Elementa IV–V & Corollarium (1678, pp. 5–7; Tab. 1, Figs. 7–8)
entries.topic: Planar and 3D non-planar skew quadrilateral ('non in eodem plano'): coplanarity and concurrency of opposite-side fulcrum joins

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Prop. VI (1678, pp. 7–8; Tab. 1, Fig. 10)
entries.topic: Pure Euclidean similar-triangle proof via parallel line through vertex A credited to Pietro Paolo Caravaggio Jr.
entries.sister_locus: Elements I.29, VI.2, VI.4 (similar triangles on parallel transversal)

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Props. IX–XXII (1678, pp. 12–35; Tab. 1–3) + Rational Trigonometry
entries.topic: Concurrency of medians X(2), altitudes X(4), angle bisectors X(1), symmedians X(6), and radical-free Spread Ceva Theorem
entries.sister_locus: ETC X(1)–X(8); Wildberger Divine Proportions vertex spreads & quadrances

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Primus, Props. XXIII–XXVI (1678, pp. 36–43; Tab. 3, Figs. 28–31)
entries.topic: 3D Tetrahedron & Pyramid 7-Line Static Equilibrium ('mira quadam concordia' at spatial center O)
entries.sister_locus: Commandino Liber de centro gravitatis solidorum (1565); Elements XII

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Secundus, Lemma I & Prop. I + Corollarium (1678, pp. 45–50; Tab. 4, Figs. 32–37)
entries.topic: Borelli–Serenus cylindrical ellipse projection, Gergonne contact point X(7), and Isotomic Conjugate Nagel point X(8)
entries.sister_locus: ETC X(7) & X(8); affine conic tangency invariance

entries.ceva_locus: Liber Secundus, Props. II–XIV (1678, pp. 50–72; Tab. 4–7, Figs. 38–61)
entries.topic: Multilateral generalization: cyclic opposite-side ratio product = 1 for any odd (2m + 1)-gon
entries.sister_locus: Carnot Essai sur la théorie des transversales (1806); odd-polygon concurrency

entries.ceva_locus: Appendix Geometrica, Props. I–XVI & Closing Scholium (1678, pp. 73–104; Tab. 8–10, Figs. 62–85)
entries.topic: Pure area-ratio proofs ([PAB]/[PAC] = BD/DC), Hippocratean lune, cylindrical ungula = 2/3 prism, Valerio 5:3 hemisphere CG, Torricelli 2:1 paraboloid CG, and Cavalieri curved-surface indivisibles caution
entries.sister_locus: Elements VI.1, XII.2; Archimedes Method & Sphere and Cylinder I.33
